name: plain
style: Hand-drawn illustration, flat shapes, soft limited palette, quiet and clean. No 3D render, no CGI.
character: a composed adult person, seen from far away, at their desk
layout: Extreme long shot. The person occupies only the bottom-right corner, about 15% of the frame. The other 85% stays open and uncluttered for desktop icons.
motion: Locked-off camera, one continuous take, no cuts, and the last frame lands back on the first so the loop has no seam. Only small motion: she shifts her weight, turns a page, breathes; loose fabric and hair move in a slow breeze; the view outside drifts on its own. Nothing enters or leaves the frame, nothing changes size, and no new object appears.

scenes.desc: a bright morning through a large window, low sun across the floor
rain running down the glass, everything outside soft and grey
a city at night far below, small lights, quiet
low hills fading into haze, nothing urgent out there

interactions.desc: working at the desk in the same frame
looking up from the screen, chin on hand
leaning back in a long stretch

room: Kept things stand on a shelf, on the windowsill, or on the wall.
note_layout: Long shot for the room, but the note is a foreground object: she holds it out toward the camera at full arm length, square to the camera, so it reads large and sharp in the bottom-right of the frame. Everything left of centre and everything above her stays open and uncluttered for desktop icons.

notePoses.desc: turned toward us and holding up a small square of paper, flat and square to the camera
holding a small whiteboard up with both hands, its face square to the camera
pressing a note flat against the window glass beside her

idle: standing at the window, doing nothing in particular
